title: Taste of Little Havana: Miami Cuban Food & Culture Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Immerse yourself in the vibrant flavors and culture of Miami’s Little Havana on this guided walking food tour. As you explore the historic streets of this Cuban neighborhood, your guide will share fascinating insights into its rich history and culinary traditions. Enjoy a variety of tastings at family-owned eateries—examples include savory beef empanadas, classic Cuban sandwiches, and refreshing mojitos, with plenty more delicious bites along the way. Watch skilled cigar rollers at work and take in the sounds of traditional Cuban music. All food and drinks are included in the ticket price for a fun and flavorful experience.
